categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including ownership details, property extents, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content focuses on land property matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
